evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This should take about five to ten minutes of your time then we'll be able to build you an accurate quote you can depend on, sounds good. — Rep says it but customer doesn't explicitly confirm 'yes' before moving into agenda question.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Confirmed moving date (first week of November), route (Port Lavaca to Dallas), customer name (Kim Smith), and inventory (sofa, kitchen table, six chairs, queen bed, miscellaneous chairs, lawn mower, fifteen boxes). All four gathered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: What are your biggest concerns or what are the most important things that you wanted to answer during this call? — Asked before any logistics probing. Customer raised: BBB/insurance, punctuality, furniture preparation (bubble wrap/pads).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep acknowledged concerns (insurance, punctuality, furniture wrapping) but did not probe deeper with 'tell me more about that.' Rep moved to logistics probing instead of following up on why punctuality mattered or what specific prep concerns existed.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Rep moved directly from customer concerns into logistics questions without restating what was heard.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (one-story house to townhouse), floor/stories (both confirmed), rooms (1 bedroom apartment equivalent at origin, 3 at destination), walking distance (30 seconds at destination, 3 hours away at origin), access (driveway, French doors, raised house with steps, no obstacles at destination), special items (furniture list, boxes). Nearly complete.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. Customer volunteered 'maybe fifteen boxes' but rep did not ask a typical box count or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: A typical one bedroom apartment normally takes two movers between two and a half to three and a half hours. — Range given and personalized to this customer's two-day split move and six-hour distance. Anchored and personalized both present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Hourly rate ($104/hour), trip fee ($768), overnight fee ($240), truck/gas/insurance/pads/wraps all included, minimum 2.5 hours, $5 increments disclosed. 'No hidden fees of any type' stated. Both fee transparency and 'not a guess' commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep gave final estimate ($6,440) and customer asked 'bottom line, what is the cost?' Rep answered, then customer said 'Okay, alright, thank you so much.' Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' and never held silence for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: If you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill. — Discount terms clearly stated, fully delivered.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: We have no worry damage coverage included on the already weight that you're paying us. We will provide up to 2000 dollars per move. That is the repair replace and reimburse for your items. — Coverage amount and built-in framing ('included on the already weight') present, but 'no deductible/no fine print' framing not explicitly stated. Partial.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar. Call ends abruptly after customer thanks rep.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Call does not reach Section 6. Rep jumps from price to 'Would you like me to send you the email?' with no final genuine concerns check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep offers to send email ('Would you like me to send you the email?') but never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. Call ends without a direct booking ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No language about rate hold or locking in the quote.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. No booking date, phone, arrival window, crew size, addresses re-confirmed, or notes left for crew. Call ends with rep offering to send email.

top_strength: Rep methodically gathered all discovery basics and logistics details (property type, access, walking distance, floor count, item inventory) and articulated a clear, anchored, two-day estimate with full fee transparency and both Two Promises delivered.
coaching_note: The call stalls after price: rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' to confirm the estimate, never checks for final concerns, and ends without an explicit ask for the business or any booking confirmation — customer is left hanging at 'Would you like me to send you the email?' instead of being guided to a yes-or-no decision.
booking_note: Customer received quote ($6,440) and thanked the agent, but never explicitly agreed to book the move or confirm a date/time. Call ends with agent offering to send email, no commitment made.
